sents.zh: 七百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫元朝。
sents.en: More than seven hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Yuan.

sents.zh: 那时候的大王叫忽必烈。
sents.en: Its great khan was called Kublai.

sents.zh: 他的国家非常大，从东边一直到很远的西边。
sents.en: His realm was vast, reaching from the east far into the west.

sents.zh: 因为路上比以前安全，所以来往的人多了。
sents.en: Because the roads were safer than before, more people travelled.

sents.zh: 那时候有一个年轻人从意大利出发。
sents.en: A young man set out from Italy in those days.

sents.zh: 他和家里人一起走，走了三年多才到。
sents.en: He travelled with his family, and it took more than three years to arrive.

sents.zh: 他们过了山，也过了很热的地方。
sents.en: They crossed mountains, and very hot country.

sents.zh: 到了中国以后，他在大都住了十七年。
sents.en: After reaching China he lived in Dadu for seventeen years.

sents.zh: 他看到了很多城，也看到了很多人。
sents.en: He saw many cities and many people.

sents.zh: 他说，中国的城比他自己国家的城大很多。
sents.en: He said China’s cities were far larger than those of his own country.

sents.zh: 他也很奇怪，这里的人用纸做的钱。
sents.en: He was struck too that people here used money made of paper.

sents.zh: 回国以后，他把看到的事情说给别人听。
sents.en: After going home he told others what he had seen.

sents.zh: 有人把他说的话写成了一本书。
sents.en: Someone wrote down what he said, making a book.

sents.zh: 因为有这本书，欧洲人第一次知道了东边的世界。
sents.en: Because of that book, Europeans first learned of the world to the east.
